news.title: Midnight Season 2 is live
news.body: New dungeon pool, Mistcrest upgrades, and the new low-key Lindormi's Guidance affix. Great Vault raid slots now reward one difficulty above what you killed.

news.title: Rebuilt from the ground up
news.body: New tools for score planning, the Great Vault, crest upgrades, and PvP goals. Character lookups and score data come live from raider.io.

news.title: Midnight Season 1 is live
news.body: Eight-dungeon pool, the new Dawncrest upgrade system, and Xal'atath's Bargain weekly affixes. Keystone Legend sits at 3000 again.
